name: Solbiate con Cagno (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Solbiate con Cagno (quartered: a knight, a sun, a dog and a tower) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI SOLBIATE CON CAGNO in grey arched above.
history: The flag was granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 23 March 2023.
